_doc: Endgame Phase 1A: the Atlas of Ruin (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Hex map in axial coords (q, r); the hub is the centre hex (ring 0). Each ring is one painting layer. A hex's biome, boss, vantage flag and base modifiers derive from hash(atlas_seed, q, r); only revealed hexes and clear counts are saved (character save key 'atlas'). Ring stats replace the biome zone def's tier scaling.
unlock_text: Defeat Malgrath in the Nightmare Vaults (Tier 5)

rot._doc: Endgame Phase 1C: Rot, the spreading decay (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Per-hex level 0-5, saved as atlas.rot {key: level}. A new atlas plants `sources` hexes at Rot `source_level` in rings >= min_ring. Each completed zone advances `fronts` (+1 per festered Heart since the last spread): a front adds +1 to the not-restored hex in rings >= min_ring that is a Rot hex or next to one, picked by a seeded score, while total Rot < cap_per_ring x rings revealed. Restored hexes never take Rot. Death in a zone adds +1 to that hex. levels[n-1] = the zone scaling at Rot n (heal = player life recovery multiplier, attack_speed = monster attack speed; Phase 1E tuning; move_speed = monster movement, proj_speed = monster projectile speed: Phase D2, the levers that reach kiting builds). Phase D2 dial (typical bots, docs/PHASE_D2_MEASUREMENTS.md): ~85% wins at Rot 3, ~65% at Rot 4 + 2 Pigments, ~45% at Rot 5 + 2 Pigments.

heart._doc: At Rot >= heart_at the hex boss is the Heart of Rot: rot_mutations from its enemies.json entry (seeded order per hex), phase thresholds moved up by phase_shift, extra life.

harvest._doc: Harvest (fester) payout per Rot level n: a guaranteed legendary, gold = monster level x gold_per_level x n, n x material_rolls materials, (n - 2) gems, n - 2 extra rares. The hex keeps its Rot and the next spread gets +1 front.

mechanics._doc: Endgame Phase 1D zone mechanics (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Each Atlas run rolls one natural mechanic at natural_chance, seeded by (atlas seed, hex, clear count), so the panel shows the next run's mechanic. Pigments (1E) will guarantee one.

list.name: Glazed Elites
list.desc: Elites wear layers of glaze, one per modifier. Each poise break peels the outer layer: the modifier is gone and a Glaze Flake drops.

list.name: The Unfinished
list.desc: Some packs are only sketches: immune until painted with the status colours on their outline (or slowly by any hits). Painted sketches drop loot as one rank higher and Pigment Dust.

list.name: The Collector's Wager
list.desc: A gaunt art collector waits mid-zone and offers 3 bets on your own play. Stake gold at 1x, 2x or 3x; a win pays the stake back with profit plus materials, a loss costs only the stake.

list.name: Pentimento Vaults
list.desc: Shimmering walls hide painted-over rooms. Damage the wall to scrape it away; its plaque tells you first whether it holds Treasure, a Trap (elite ambush, double loot) or a Riddle (strike the sigils in order).

mechanics.minor_doc: Endgame Phase 2D: 'minor' mechanics (wager, vault) never take the main natural roll; each rolls on its own at `chance` (x the Blooming Varnish multiplier), seeded by (atlas seed, hex, clear count), so a zone can have Glazed/Unfinished plus a Wager and Vaults.

glazed._doc: elite_chance_mult on the zone's elite chance; every elite is glazed with layers = its modifiers, raised to min_layers (extra random modifiers) and capped at max_layers. Burst poise: a hit adds damage / max life / fill_fraction x 100 (big hits up to big_hit_multiplier); a stun or freeze adds stun_poise; the bar drains decay_per_sec all the time, so only fast damage or frequent stuns fill it. 100 = peel the outer layer (1 Flake), then stagger s and peel_immunity s of poise immunity. On death the remaining layers shatter into Flakes: all if killed within shatter_fast s of the first hit, none after shatter_slow s, linear between. Every layer gone (peeled + shattered): +full_bonus Flakes, +1 per 2 Rot, +full_rarity_bonus rarity.

unfinished._doc: pack_chance of packs (at least min_packs) are sketched. Each pack needs `colours` status colours (+1 at Rot >= extra_colour_rot or ring >= extra_colour_ring, max max_colours), seeded per pack. A sketch takes no life damage; the right status (from any source) fills its colour, and every hit or DoT tick also adds to a neutral raw fill (damage it would have taken / max life); raw_fill reached = painted. Painted by colour: loot as one rank higher (normal -> elite rolls, elite -> + elite_rarity_bonus) and dust Pigment Dust (elites x elite_dust). Painted by raw fill: rank-up loot only.

wager._doc: Endgame Phase 2D: the Collector stands in a mid-depth chamber. Interact to see `offers` bets (seeded per run, only bets the zone supports). One bet per zone. The stake (gold) = round(stake_per_level x zone level) x stake multiplier and is taken when you accept. Win: gold back = stake x (1 + odds) x (1 + rot_bonus x Rot), plus materials_per_mult x mult random materials, flakes_per_mult x mult Glaze Flakes, dust_per_mult x mult Pigment Dust, and at 3x a rare item at +rare_rarity rarity. Loss (condition broken, time out, death, or the zone boss dying first for 'next elite'/'count' bets): the stake is gone. Placeholders in text: {time} {count} {skills} {life}. boss_rush time = base_time + per_chamber x chambers from the Collector to the boss arena. Phase D2 (re-tuned with typical bots to ~60% wins and +15% expected gold, docs/PHASE_D2_MEASUREMENTS.md; was Phase 2E: bot-tuned to ~60% Competent wins where a bet has a number to tune; odds set for about +15% expected gold): Unscathed allows max_hits hits; Frenzy is only offered with min_monsters monsters in the chambers from the Collector onward (Unscathed needs an elite there); Archaeology and Colourist are timed (count bets with a `time` lose when it runs out); Archaeology is refused once no sealed vault is left. Abstinence (~87%) and Economy of Means (1 skill, ~93%) have no number to tune and pay low odds instead.

bets.text: Slay the next elite taking no more than {hits} hits

bets.text: Slay the zone boss within {time} seconds

bets.text: Slay the zone boss using only {skills} skill

bets.text: Peel {count} glaze layers before the zone boss dies

vault._doc: Endgame Phase 2D: `count` vaults per zone (+1 at ring >= extra_ring or Rot >= extra_rot, max max). Each is a pocket (pocket x pocket cells) carved into solid rock behind a chamber wall, reached by a mouth (mouth cells deep, 2 wide) sealed by a shimmering wall. The wall is an object with `life` base life (scaled like a monster of the zone level and Rot); destroying it opens the vault. Type seeded per vault by weight (the plaque shows it). Treasure: a cache. Trap: `trap.elites` elites + a pack inside, aggro, loot x trap.loot_mult; the cache drops when the last trap monster dies. Riddle: `riddle.sigils` sigils in the pocket, strike them in the plaque's order; a wrong sigil resets the order and wakes riddle.wrong_pack monsters; solved = the cache + riddle.bonus_rares rares. Every opened vault also rolls a Ground Shard of the ring's layer at shard_chance + shard_rot_bonus x Rot. Vaults opened after the boss dies still pay out but do not count for contracts.

types.name: Trap
types.desc: An elite ambush; its monsters drop double loot, then a cache.

types.name: Riddle
types.desc: Strike the sigils in the order on the plaque for a richer cache.

pigments._doc: Endgame Phase 1E: Pigments (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Crafted at the Easel from the mechanic's own material; kept in atlas.pigments (stock) and atlas.easel (slotted, in order). Each slotted Pigment that fits the zone's slot count guarantees its mechanic, adds its modifier and `reward`% quantity/rarity/XP, and spends 1 charge on entering; a death in the zone spends death_charges more. Slots: `slots` base, +1 in rings >= extra_slot_ring or a Restored region, max max_slots. A modifier is seeded per craft (atlas seed + craft count); the same modifier twice stacks.

glazed.name: Thick
glazed.desc: Elites wear +1 glaze layer (up to 5); a full peel gives +1 Flake.

glazed.name: Crowded
glazed.desc: Elites are 25% more common; Glaze Flakes from peels +1.

glazed.name: Hardened
glazed.desc: Glaze poise fills 25% slower; fully peeled elites drop +150 rarity more.

glazed.name: Biting
glazed.desc: Glazed elites deal 20% more damage; every shattered layer gives +1 Flake.

unfinished.name: Two-Tone
unfinished.desc: Sketches need +1 colour (up to 3); colour-painted sketches drop +1 Dust.

unfinished.name: Crowded
unfinished.desc: 15% more packs are sketches; painted sketches drop +100 rarity.

unfinished.name: Stubborn
unfinished.desc: Raw fill needs 85% of life instead of 60%; filled-in sketches always drop Dust.

unfinished.name: Vivid
unfinished.desc: Sketches deal 20% more damage; a status paints its colour and adds 15% raw fill.

varnish._doc: Endgame Phase 1E: Varnish slots, the light version of the Easel board. Varnishes are rule-changers (a bonus with a penalty) that edit zone parameters only, never character stats. They drop from Hearts of Rot: guaranteed on Harvest, restore_chance on Restore. Kept as counts in atlas.varnish; atlas.varnish_slots holds the slotted ids (one of each). Slots: `slots` base + 1 per ring fully cleared, max max_slots. Slotted Varnishes are never used up.

list.name: Thin Varnish
list.desc: Rot spreads 1 fewer front (at least 1), but a Heart of Rot only appears from Rot 4.

list.name: Dense Varnish
list.desc: Packs are 25% larger and drop 20% more items, but elites are 30% rarer.

list.name: Lacquered Varnish
list.desc: Elites are 50% more common with +1 modifier, but packs are 15% smaller.

list.name: Binding Varnish
list.desc: Pigments you craft have +2 charges, but you can slot only 1 Pigment per zone.

list.name: Blooming Varnish
list.desc: Natural zone mechanics roll twice as often, but monsters deal 10% more damage.

list.name: Greedy Varnish
list.desc: Rot rewards are 50% higher, but dying in a zone adds +1 more Rot.

fixative._doc: Endgame 2B. Blacksmith craft 'Apply Fixative': lowers an item's crafting corruption by `reduce` (never below 0). At most `max_uses` per item (item field `fixative`). Refused at 100% (sealed) and on Abyssal-Brand corrupted items. Exempt from the corruption roll. Cost: `flakes` Glaze Flakes + gold_base + gold_per_ilvl x item level.

rot_touched._doc: Endgame 2B. Item drops in an Atlas zone at Rot 4+ may be Rot-touched: one extra implicit (item field `rot_implicit` {id, tier, mods}) with a bonus and a drawback. chance by Rot level; tier 1 at Rot 4, tier 2 at Rot 5. Each pool entry: tiers[t-1] = [bonus min, bonus max, drawback]; bonus/drawback = {stat, type}. Own seeded stream; never rolled outside Atlas Rot zones.

guild._doc: Endgame Phase 2C: the Commission Board and the Restorers' Guild (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE2.md). A hub NPC holds `slots` contracts (+1 at rank 4). Contracts progress only from completed Atlas zones (credited when the zone boss dies; the Heart choice is credited when made). A completed contract pays rep (reputation) and seals at once; its slot shows done until the board refreshes every `refresh_every` completed zones (done contracts replaced, `rerolls` free rerolls and the vendor limit reset). Contract rewards: rep = round(rep x need + rep_base), seals = max(1, round(seals x need + seals_base)). `cache_cost` Seals open one of the `cache_offer` caches on offer (+1 at rank 4), seeded per cache opened. Ranks are reached by total reputation; `unlocks`: board, vendor (Pigments for gold, `per_refresh` per refresh), fixative (the Blacksmith's Apply Fixative), slot4, cache4. State: atlas.guild (per character).

wardens._doc: Endgame Phase 2A: Layer Wardens (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE2.md). Each ring has a Warden: an upgraded existing boss. Clearing a region of that ring can drop a Ground Shard of its layer (kept in atlas.shards, per ring). With `summon_cost` shards the player summons the Warden at any cleared region of that ring (atlas.summons); the next run there fights the Warden instead of the hex boss (no Heart). Shards are spent only on victory. A Warden kill drops a Ground Pigment of its layer: always on the first kill, then `ground_chance`, guaranteed after `ground_pity` dry kills. The first kill of each Warden also gives +1 passive point. Ground Pigments are banked for the pinnacle (any `pinnacle_need` of 6 layers, Phase 3). Phase D2: ring damage_mult tuned so a typical bot wins ~60% of Rot 5 Warden runs (ring 2 0.4, ring 3 1.1; ring 1 never has Rot).

rings.title: the Varnish Warden
rings.desc: Sir Morcant, sealed under the first coat. Glaze tides and lacquer volleys; hardens at 30% life.

final_phase.message: The varnish cracks - Sir Morcant hardens!

rings.title: the Craquelure Warden
rings.desc: The Gravemaw, living in the cracks. Fault lines split the floor; falling flakes at 25% life.

final_phase.message: The ground splits beneath the Gravemaw!

rings.title: the Pentimento Warden
rings.desc: Archon Velis, painted over and painted again. Underpainting spirals and ghost sigils; peels back her image at 15% life.

final_phase.message: Velis peels back her own image!
